title: RoboCup Soccer 2023 Winner Paper
description: Our NimbRo platform paper covers the perception, kicking, and gait modules behind the 2023 Humanoid AdultSize win.
body: Our RoboCup Humanoid 2023 winner paper was accepted for publication at RoboCup 2023: Robot World Cup XXVI.
The paper describes our winning robot platform, including the latest updates to the robot perception, kicking, and gait modules.
